title: A Note About 2023 Course Updates
summary: Short announcement article: the bootcamp, first made in 2018, was re-recorded through 2023, so most of the material is new. It names the new topics and explains the move from MongoDB to PostgreSQL.

concepts.heading: What changed in the 2023 rebuild
points: Around 80% of the course was re-recorded, with more than 50 hours of fresh video added.
Whole new sections were created for CSS Flexbox, CSS Grid and PostgreSQL.
The database part of the course switched from MongoDB (NoSQL) to PostgreSQL (SQL), based on hiring research showing employers want SQL skills more than Mongo/NoSQL.

Takeaway for study planning: older forum answers, blog posts or GitHub repos may refer to the 2018-era version (e.g. Mongo/Mongoose lessons), so check that any outside material matches the current section order.

pitfalls: (Extra) Mixing up course versions: tutorials or repos labelled with older course years may follow the old MongoDB track instead of the current Postgres one.
